description:
[Live TLS socket inspection. Read-only, non-destructive, side-effect free]. Connects to target host port (default 443) to inspect X.509 certificate validity and expiration, Subject Alternative Names (SANs), TLS protocol version (TLS 1.2/1.3), cipher suite strength, HTTP security headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options), and /.well-known/security.txt.
Usage: Use this tool to assess web transport security and HTTPS certificate health. For domain ownership age, use 'domain_rdap_intel'. For exposed internal ports, use 'port_leak_detector'.
Returns: JSON object with { hostname: string, port: number, certificate: { valid: boolean, daysUntilExpiration: number, issuer: string, sans: string[] }, tlsVersion: string, cipherSuite: string, securityHeaders: { hsts: boolean, csp: boolean, xfo: boolean }, securityTxtFound: boolean, securityScore: number }.

hostname.description: Domain or hostname to inspect (e.g. novapixel.it)

name: tls_http_inspector
